claims: CBSE Class 10th Result 2026 (Phase 1) was officially declared on April 15, 2026.
CBSE Class 10 2026 results have a pass percentage of 93.70%.
Girls have a 94.99% pass rate for CBSE Class 10 2026.
Boys have a 92.69% pass rate for CBSE Class 10 2026.
CBSE board maintained its policy of not releasing a merit list or topper list for 2026 Class 10 results.
A second optional board exam (Phase 2) for CBSE Class 10 is scheduled for May 2026.
